title: Use logging for data validation errors
body: Replace debugging print statements with appropriate Python logging. Keep the existing validation behavior unchanged.

title: Add FastAPI churn prediction service
body: Implement GET /health and POST /predict. Use English API field names, reuse the existing feature engineering, add automated API tests, and document how to run the API locally.

title: Add Docker image for the churn API
body: Create a Dockerfile for the FastAPI service. Include the application dependencies and provide the trained model artifact. Verify that the container starts and serves requests.

title: Add a container smoke test
body: Test that the Docker container starts, GET /health succeeds, and POST /predict returns a valid response.

title: Publish verified Docker images to GHCR
body: Extend GitHub Actions to publish verified images to GitHub Container Registry. Tag images with the relevant commit SHA and prevent publishing when required checks fail.

title: Translate Python identifiers and messages into English
body: Translate Swedish Python function names, variables, comments, docstrings, test names, and messages into English. Update all imports and references consistently. Do not modify CSV files, their filenames, contents, or column headers.

title: Ensure invalid data blocks model training
body: Verify that invalid data stops the actual pipeline before training. Preserve the test that checks rejection of the known-bad CSV and demonstrate both successful and failed pipeline runs.
